ambiguities_or_notes: The working title «Погибший» is rendered as “The Lost Man”; the source title is translated rather than replaced or transliterated.
The publishing measure «листа в 3» is rendered as “about three printer's sheets.”
In context, «положительный ответ» is rendered as “a definite answer,” avoiding the unsupported implication that Tolstoy specifically asks for a favorable answer.
